name: Merge video clips, voiceover and captions into one MP4 with Apify

parameters.content:
## Assemble supplied media into an MP4

You supply 1-10 clips, optional narration audio and optional timed SRT captions. This tool assembles them; it does not generate media or caption timing.

### 1. Connect Apify
In **Assemble video on Apify**, add a Header Auth credential: Name: Authorization; Value: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN. Never paste your token into workflow JSON.

### 2. Try the free demo
Leave **Set video job** unchanged (clips: []). Execute once. The cached 12-second demo returns demo=true and charged=false.

### 3. Choose a real render
Replace the entire JSON in **Set video job** with the sample in the note below, or your own public media URLs. Review the $0.20 charge before executing. An empty clips list always returns the demo.

### Price and limits
$0.20 per successfully assembled video. Failed renders incur no video-assembly charge. The demo has no video-assembly charge; compute is still incurred by the operator.

Up to 10 clips and 60 seconds of output; 200 MB/file, 600 MB total downloads. Original clip audio is discarded. No per-clip trimming. You supply caption timing. Save the MP4 promptly to your own storage; the returned link is not permanent.

Do not automatically retry a timed-out request: a render may still be running. Check Apify Runs first.

### Duration and ownership
Output duration is the shorter of total clip duration and max_seconds. Narration and timed captions must fit that output duration. Incompatible jobs are rejected before rendering, without a video-assembly charge. max_seconds does not extend footage. Use only media you are authorized to process.

Maintained by Agent Utility Labs, which operates the paid Actor. Published template: https://n8n.io/workflows/20412

### 1. Demo or paid input
Empty clips list = cached free demo.
Non-empty clips list = real render, $0.20 per successfully assembled video.

Use the copyable sample below, or your own public clip URLs. Voiceover and timed SRT captions are optional.

### 2. Assemble video on Apify
Select your own Header Auth credential:
Name `Authorization`
Value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Runtime varies with media. This request waits up to 5 minutes; a timeout does not cancel the Actor. Check Apify Runs before retrying.

### 3. Check the result
Demo: demo=true, charged=false.
Real render: demo=false; charged reflects the actual billing result.

Save video_url to your own storage promptly. Do not count a successful free demo as a paid video.

nodes.name: Optional paid sample - review price first

parameters.content:
## Optional first real render - $0.20 on successful assembly
Copy this JSON into **Set video job**, replacing its contents, only when ready to pay. Then execute manually. The default input above remains free.

This is an 8-second silent example with supplied caption timing, using a NASA public-domain clip from our tested showcase. NASA does not endorse this tool. External source availability can change.

```json
{
  "clips": [
    "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f1/SDO_Video_Toolkit_%28SVS14126_-_Canyon_of_Fire_New-Slow%29.webm"
  ],
  "voiceover_url": null,
  "captions_srt": "1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,000\nMy first assembled video\n\n2\n00:00:04,000 --> 00:00:08,000\nFootage: NASA (public domain)\n",
  "orientation": "vertical",
  "fit": "pad",
  "max_seconds": 8
}
```

Expected: demo=false, status=ok and an MP4 URL. Check charged for the actual charge result. Add your own voiceover URL if you want narration; clip audio is discarded.
